rule_gaps: '-strikk' (harstrikk, treningsstrikk, ribbestrikket) matches the yarn/knitting vocabulary and pulls hair ties, fitness bands and knitted clothing into Hobby
'lerretsbilde'/'canvasbilde' under Innredning/Interior is wall decor (Home), but 'lerret' matches the painting-canvas vocabulary - 27 of 300 rows in this shard
'stoff'/'ribbestoff' as an upholstery material matches the sewing vocabulary (JYSK bar stool, Nettdyret dog beds and cat baskets)
Jernia's 'Maling og oppussing > Olje og lakk > Spraymaling' resolves through the art-supply 'maling' rule; DIY paint from a hardware chain should reach Tools
facetrules has no 'turquoise'/'aqua' colour word - missed on every occurrence here (Cernit 676 Turquoise, Diamond Dotz 8177 Pale Turquoise, Bilde Shiny Stones Turquoise)
Hobbii yarn and pattern rows carry no craft word in the name, so facets.type is underivable for ~40 of them; only stored enrichment would fill it
notes: Hobby is the catch-all for any name containing strikk/stoff/lerret/maling: 47 of 300 rows belong in another category, 27 of them Trademax/Chilli canvas wall art that should be Home. The genuine art and craft rows are correctly filed, but Tegne.no and Outland publish no brand so 119 rows sit at 'Unspecified' (or a shop placeholder like 'ANDRE MERKEVARER'/'Oklassificerat') with the manufacturer plainly in the name, and colour/size ranges (Copic, Daniel Smith, Diamond Dotz, stretcher bars) sit as separate top-level products. 149 of 300 rows still have no image, consistent with sampled-shop crawls.
